name: VADER
author: L'Cronx
summary: An orbit-based vector synth: an orbiter travels a shape (15 built in, two in 3D, or your own SVG, OBJ, PNG or JPG) across four corners of overtone generators, blends and filters. Two timbres, arpeggiator, drive, chorus, delay, reverb. Its screen runs on your phone: tap the logo for the QR code and scan it, load shapes from the phone too.
